prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: Best for brand-consistent campaigns using your own assets
answer_verbatim:
There is **no single universally best** AI video ad maker; the strongest choice depends on your ad format and workflow.[2][10][20]

If you want the **best all-around pick**, the most consistently recommended option in the results is **HeyGen**.[1][17] One review says HeyGen ranked first because it combined avatar quality, multilingual reach, and automated ad creation, and another says it is the best overall AI video tool for marketing and ads.[1][17]

If your priority is **e-commerce product ads** or fast variation testing, **Creatify** is the most common alternative top pick.[2][4][10][15] Multiple sources describe it as the strongest overall choice for video ads, especially for product-url-based or e-commerce workflows.[2][4][10]

A practical way to choose:

- **Best overall:** HeyGen[1][17]
- **Best for e-commerce/product ads:** Creatify[2][4][10][15]
- **Best for UGC-style performance ads:** Arcads[7][10]
- **Best for social media ad workflows:** VEED[2]
- **Best for brand-consistent campaigns using your own assets:** ngram[5]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best free**, **best budget**, or **best for Meta/TikTok/YouTube ads** option.
